blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — Thousands of residents and tourists filled the streets of Bacolod over the weekend as dancers in colorful costumes and the festival’s signature smiling masks brought the 2026 MassKara Festival street dancing and arena competitions to life. The festivities culminated in performances at the SM City Bacolod grounds, where competing contingents showcased elaborate choreography, vibrant costumes and intricate masks. Eight barangays competed in the festival’s main street dancing and arena competition on Sunday, Oct. 18, with results still pending as of press time.
